annotations.title: Brazil monetary correction (official BCB SGS indices)

description: Restates a BRL amount between two dates with the official Central Bank of Brazil SGS series (IPCA, IGPM, INPC, SELIC or CDI) and returns the corrected amount, accumulated percentage, compounding factor, SGS series id and month count. Use it for contract and rent readjustment, judicial arrears, inflation-adjusted pricing and receivable updates. Do not use it to convert between currencies (use br_convert_ptax_fx) or to build installment plans (use br_simulate_loan_amortization). Read-only and idempotent: it writes nothing and the same window plus index always returns the same figure, so a retry is safe and never double-charges beyond the per-call price. It fetches live BCB data, so months BCB has not published yet are simply skipped and monthsCount reveals how many observations were applied. Costs 0.005 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and a BCB outage or malformed input returns a JSON body with success:false plus an error code, never an exception, so an agent loop never breaks.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default), appends aiExecutiveBrief, a one-sentence Portuguese summary generated at the edge. Set false to cut roughly 80 ms of latency and the extra tokens.

amountBRL.description: Nominal amount in BRL to restate, as a plain number (10000 means R$ 10.000,00). Must be greater than zero.

endDate.description: Inclusive end of the correction window as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after startDate; if it falls in a month BCB has not published, that month is skipped instead of failing.

includeBreakdown.description: When true, also returns monthlyBreakdown with each month's rate and running factor. Enlarges the payload but costs nothing extra and adds no latency.

index.description: Official BCB SGS series to apply. IPCA is headline consumer inflation and the default choice for judicial and general contract correction; IGPM is the market standard for commercial rent; INPC tracks lower-income baskets and labour agreements; SELIC and CDI accumulate interest rather than inflation and are used for financial restatement. Choosing SELIC or CDI usually yields a larger correction than IPCA over the same window.

startDate.description: Inclusive start of the correction window as YYYY-MM-DD. The BCB series is monthly, so any day inside a month selects that whole month.

name: br_correct_monetary_value

aiExecutiveBrief.description: One-sentence Portuguese summary of the result. Omitted when aiSummary is false.

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code. Common values: 'bad_request' (malformed JSON or missing operation), 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path).

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

monetaryCorrection.description: The correction result. Check its ok field before reading the amounts.

accumulatedFactor.description: Compounded multiplier applied to the original amount (1.09452 means +9.452%).

accumulatedPct.description: Accumulated variation over the window in percent (9.452 means +9.452%).

correctedAmountBRL.description: Restated amount in BRL, rounded to 2 decimals.

correctionDeltaBRL.description: Difference between corrected and original amount in BRL.

endDate.description: End of the window actually applied, YYYY-MM-DD.

error.description: Portuguese reason, present only when ok is false (invalid index or BCB SGS HTTP failure).

index.description: Index actually applied; echoes the index argument.

indexDescription.description: Human-readable name of the BCB series applied.

monthlyBreakdown.description: Month-by-month detail, present only when includeBreakdown is true.

accumulatedFactor.description: Running compounded factor up to and including that month.

month.description: Reference month as returned by BCB, DD/MM/YYYY.

ratePct.description: Index variation for that single month, in percent.

monthsCount.description: Number of monthly observations compounded; lower than expected means BCB has not published the tail months yet.

ok.description: true when the BCB SGS series answered for the requested window; false when BCB was unreachable or the index was rejected.

sgsSeriesId.description: Numeric BCB SGS series identifier used, for example 433 for IPCA.

startDate.description: Start of the window actually applied, YYYY-MM-DD.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement.

success.description: false when the call was rejected before any calculation ran. Absent on success paths that return success:true.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs in the same suite that are commonly called right after this one. Purely advisory, never required.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the suggested follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the suggested follow-up call, in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up call is worth making.
